But auth is mock, so no actual Keycloak login. The KEYCLOAK_ADMIN may be needed for IAM user management but might be optional at runtime.

The builder profile needs `VITE_PUBLIC_BUILDER_KEY` which is a Builder.io API key - external. Hmm.
